topArchetypes.name: Lockdown Move
topArchetypes.description: The longest-running top Move deck; doesn't rely solely on movement for its win condition, giving it outs other Move decks lack. Built around long-time Move staples (Scream, Kraven, Sam Wilson Captain America, Aero) rather than any single season's keyword, so it survived the Moveable-to-Quickdraw season transition intact.
